∀ {s s' : Minidregg.Pred.State}, (∀ (k : Minidregg.Pred.Slot), s.get k = s'.get k) → ∀ (vs : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot), s.getAll vs = s'.getAll vs

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (l : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.evalWithAll O (Minidregg.Pred.PredList.ofList l) old new = l.all fun q => Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O q old new

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (l : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.evalWithAny O (Minidregg.Pred.PredList.ofList l) old new = l.any fun q => Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O q old new

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (ps : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all ps) old new = ps.all fun q => Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O q old new

∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (ps : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.any ps) old new = ps.any fun q => Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O q old new
∀ (O : Minidregg.Pred.Oracle) (p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O p.not old new = !Minidregg.Pred.evalWith O p old new
∀ (ps : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.all ps) old new = ps.all fun q => Minidregg.Pred.eval q old new
∀ (ps : List Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.any ps) old new = ps.any fun q => Minidregg.Pred.eval q old new
∀ (p : Minidregg.Pred.Pred) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval p.not old new = !Minidregg.Pred.eval p old new

∀ (artifacts : List ℕ) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin artifacts) old new = Bool.true ↔ ∃ a ∈ artifacts, new.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some (Int.ofNat a)

∀ (left right : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.sumEq left right) old new = Bool.true ↔ ∃ xs ys, List.mapM new.get left = Option.some xs ∧ List.mapM new.get right = Option.some ys ∧ xs.sum = ys.sum
Minidregg.Theory.HashBytes.Hash → Minidregg.Pred.State → List Minidregg.Pred.Slot → Minidregg.Pred.Slot → Minidregg.Pred.Slot → Bool
Minidregg.Pred.State → List Minidregg.Pred.Slot → Minidregg.Pred.Slot → Minidregg.Pred.Slot → Option Minidregg.Pred.HashEqDigest.Opening

Prop := (∃ old new, Minidregg.Pred.eval Minidregg.Pred.demoPred old new = Bool.true) ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.monotone "x") Minidregg.Pred.sX3 Minidregg.Pred.sX5 = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.monotone "x") Minidregg.Pred.sX5 Minidregg.Pred.sX3 = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.witnessed { id := "vk-1" }) Minidregg.Pred.sX3 Minidregg.Pred.sX5 = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Pred.evalWith (fun x x_1 x_2 => Bool.true) (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.witnessed { id := "vk-1" }) Minidregg.Pred.sX3 Minidregg.Pred.sX5 = Bool.true

∀ (artifacts : List ℕ) (old new : Minidregg.Pred.State), new.get Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot = Option.some (-1) → Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin artifacts) old new = Bool.false

Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin [7]) { slots := [] } { slots := [(Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, 7)] } = Bool.true ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin [8]) { slots := [] } { slots := [(Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, 7)] } = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.objectivePin [7, 8]) { slots := [] } { slots := [(Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, -1), (Minidregg.Pred.objectiveArtifactSlot, 7)] } = Bool.false

Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.ran 7) Minidregg.Pred.sX3 Minidregg.Pred.sX5 = Bool.false ∧ Minidregg.Pred.eval (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.ran 8) Minidregg.Pred.sX3 { slots := [(Minidregg.Pred.ranSlot 7, 1)] } = Bool.false
∀ {s s' : Minidregg.Pred.State}, (∀ (k : Minidregg.Pred.Slot), s.get k = s'.get k) → ∀ (slots : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot), Minidregg.Pred.sumOf s slots = Minidregg.Pred.sumOf s' slots

∀ (state : Minidregg.Pred.State) (slots : List Minidregg.Pred.Slot) (total : ℤ), Minidregg.Pred.sumOf state slots = Option.some total ↔ ∃ values, List.mapM state.get slots = Option.some values ∧ values.sum = total
Minidregg.Pred.evalWith (fun x x_1 x_2 => Bool.true) (Minidregg.Pred.Pred.witnessed { id := "vk-1" }) Minidregg.Pred.sX3 Minidregg.Pred.sX5 = Bool.true
